asked.item: is my Blotato account set up
how to install Claude Code and start it on Mac

verdict.reason: The help pages state that the "command not found: claude" error means Claude Code is not installed yet, and they explain how to install it and then connect Blotato.

steps.text: If Terminal says command not found: claude, Claude Code is not installed on your computer yet.
Claude Code does not come pre-installed, so install it from the official Claude Code page.
On a Mac, open Terminal by pressing Cmd + Space, typing Terminal, and pressing Enter, then type claude and press Enter to start a Claude Code session.
Once Claude Code is installed, connect Blotato: in the Blotato app go to Settings > API, click Copy Setup Command under Claude Code (Terminal), and paste it into a Claude Code session in Terminal.
